title: 第7章 小爷还没准备好第8章 约战
slug: 剑道狂神第4623章一枚令牌
lines: 谁人不知，“唐天”
资质不行，只是炼脉境修为？
以前的“唐天”
，整日唯唯诺诺，从不招惹是非。
可今日从落星森林回来之后，就仿若变了一个人。
性格大变，变得张扬，胆大！
作为父亲的唐凌云，自然没有怀疑，反而欣慰无比，认为他的儿子终于有了改变。
可现在几乎等于一个凡人的唐天，却要接受一个锻骨境强者的一击，实在是让人难以相信。
作为修者，到了锻骨境，经脉、血液、以及骨头，都产生了蜕变，就算林逸尘压制了修为，依旧比真正的焚血境修者厉害许多。
最重要的一点，有些天才修者在进入焚血境的时候，会修炼出与自己血脉息息相关命魂。
林逸尘能够成为落星宗的内门弟子，想必定然修炼出了命魂！
拥有命魂的修者，两者相结合，实力更为强大一倍不止。
若是命魂更加不凡的话，实力更是会翻倍。
“天儿，万万不可！”
唐凌云焦急不已，在他看来，唐天如此冒险绝对是必死无疑。
唐天深吸一口气，认真的说道：“父亲还请放心。”
秦月熙斜睨了一眼唐天，冷笑道：“真是不知死活，要是死在了林郎的手中，还平白的脏了他的手。”
不得不说，这个女人将不要脸发挥到了极致，这么快就将“林郎”
二字，说的如此顺口了。
林逸尘淡然道：“月熙妹妹说的对，若是真的一个不小心，杀了唐家大少爷，我怕是会被天下人耻笑。
这样吧，我改变主意了，你只要跪下磕个头道个歉，我便就这么算了。”
“放肆！”
唐啸海怒喝出声，身上强大的气息爆发，忍不住就要出手教训林逸尘。
唐天再怎么废物，那也是唐家的少爷，若是受辱，还故作不知。
整个唐家上下，都会在落星城抬不起头来。
唐啸海如此维护，倒是让唐天有些意外。
也正是如此，让他对这个陌生的家，有了一些归属感。
“叔叔，这事让我来面对吧，不用动气。”
唐天神色平静，让人看不出一点惧意。
“胡闹！
你区区一个炼脉境的小子，是想用你的小命，让我唐家丢脸吗？”
唐啸海狠狠的瞪了一眼，这小子简直是不知死活。
content_en:
Who knows, "Tang Tian"
No qualifications, just Pulse Refining Realm cultivation?
The former "Tang Tian"
, He is obedient all day long and never causes trouble.
But after returning from Falling Star Forest today, he seemed to be a different person.
His personality changed drastically, he became assertive and bold!
As a father, Tang Lingyun naturally had no doubts, but was extremely pleased, thinking that his son had finally changed.
But now Tang Tian, ​​who was almost a mortal, had to accept a blow from a strong man in the bone forging realm. It was really unbelievable.
As a cultivator, after reaching the Bone Forging Realm, the meridians, blood, and bones have all undergone transformation. Even if Lin Yichen suppresses his cultivation, he is still much more powerful than a real Blood-Burning Realm cultivator.
The most important point is that when some talented cultivators enter the Burning Blood Realm, they will cultivate life souls that are closely related to their own bloodline.
Lin Yichen was able to become an inner disciple of Luo Xing Sect, so he must have cultivated the Soul of Life!
A cultivator with a life soul is more than twice as powerful when combined with the two.
If the life soul is more extraordinary, the strength will be doubled.
"Tian'er, you absolutely must not!"
Tang Lingyun was anxious. In his opinion, Tang Tian would definitely die if he took such a risk.
Tang Tian took a deep breath and said seriously: "Father, please don't worry."
Qin Yuexi glanced sideways at Tang Tian and sneered: "You really don't know whether to live or die. If you die in Lin Lang's hands, your hands will be dirty for nothing."
I have to say that this woman took her shamelessness to the extreme, and she quickly defeated "Lin Lang"
Two words, said so smoothly.
Lin Yichen said calmly: "Sister Yue Xi is right, if I kill the eldest young master of the Tang family by accident, I'm afraid I will be ridiculed by everyone in the world.
Well, I've changed my mind. You just need to kneel down and kowtow to apologize, and I'll let it go. "
"Presumptuous!"
Tang Xiaohai shouted angrily, a powerful aura erupted from his body, and he couldn't help but want to teach Lin Yichen a lesson.
No matter how useless Tang Tian is, he is still the young master of the Tang family. If he is humiliated, he will pretend not to know.
The entire Tang family will be unable to hold their heads high in Luo Xing City.
Tang Xiaohai was so protective, which surprised Tang Tian.
It was precisely this that gave him some sense of belonging to this strange home.
"Uncle, let me face this matter, don't get angry."
Tang Tian's expression was calm, and no one could see any fear.
"Nonsense!
You, a mere Pulse Refining Realm kid, want to use your life to embarrass our Tang family? "
Tang Xiaohai glared fiercely, this kid simply didn't know how to live or die.
